blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Human Reproductive System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define reproduction. Give two functions common to both reproductive systems.
(Reproduction ki definition likhein. Dono reproductive systems ke do mushtarka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Reproduction jaandar ki apni qisam ki nayi aulad paida karne ki salahiyat hai. Dono nizam (1) gametes banate aur (2) unhein fertilization ke liye tayyar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: reproduction means the ability of an organism to produce new offspring of its own type

blocks.prompt:
2 In which two aspects is the reproductive system different from other organ systems?
(Reproductive system doosre nizamon se kin do baaton mein mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh mard aur aurat mein bohat mukhtalif hai, jab ke doosre nizam taqreeban aik jaise hain.
2. Yeh puberty tak kaam nahi karta, jab ke doosre nizam paidaish se ya foran baad kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The human reproductive system is different from other organ systems in two aspects

blocks.prompt:
3 Name the two types of cells in the germinal epithelium of seminiferous tubules with their roles.
(Seminiferous tubules ke germinal epithelium ke do qisam ke cells aur un ke kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Germline cells: meiosis se sperms banate hain.
2. Sertoli cells: banne wale sperms ko ghiza dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The wall of the seminiferous tubules i.e., germinal epithelium contains two types of cells

blocks.prompt:
4 Why are the testes located outside the abdomen in the scrotum?
(Testes pait se bahar scrotum mein kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Scrotum testes ko taqreeban 34°C par rakhta hai jo jism ke andaruni darje (37°C) se thora kam hai. Yeh kam darja sperms ki nashonuma ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: This lower temperature is required for the development of sperms

blocks.prompt:
5 What is the epididymis? What change occurs in sperms there?
(Epididymis kya hai? Wahan sperms mein kya tabdeeli aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epididymis lambi, lipti hui nali hai jo rete testis se sperms leti hai. Aate waqt sperms harkat nahi karte; wahan kam az kam 18 ghante reh kar harkat ke qabil ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Here, the spermatozoa are still non-motile

blocks.prompt:
6 How is the ejaculatory duct formed, and where does it open?
(Ejaculatory duct kaise banti hai aur kahan khulti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har testis ki vas deferens seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct banati hai. Dono ejaculatory ducts prostate gland se guzar kar urethra mein khulti hain jo penis se bahar khulti hai.

book_ref.quote: The two ejaculatory ducts coming from two testes pass through a prostate gland

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the vas deferens? Describe its course.
(Vas deferens kya hai? Is ka raasta bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vas deferens lambi nali hai jo epididymis se harkat karne wale sperms leti hai. Yeh inguinal canal se pait ke khane mein jati aur seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct banati hai.

book_ref.quote: The vas deference passes into the abdominal cavity via the inguinal canal

blocks.prompt:
8 What is semen? Name the male accessory glands.
(Semen kya hai? Male accessory glands ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Semen sperms aur seminal vesicles aur prostate gland ki ratoobat ka mixture hai. Accessory glands sperms mein ratoobat milate hain: do seminal vesicles, prostate gland aur do bulbourethral glands.

book_ref.quote: These are the glands that add fluids to sperms to form semen

blocks.prompt:
9 Define spermatogenesis. How many spermatids are produced from one spermatogonium?
(Spermatogenesis ki definition likhein. Aik spermatogonium se kitne spermatids bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Spermatogenesis woh amal hai jis se testes ki seminiferous tubules mein sperms bante hain. Aik spermatogonium (2n) chaar spermatids (1n) banata hai, har aik lamba sperm ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Spermatogenesis is the process by which sperm are formed inside the seminiferous tubules

blocks.prompt:
10 Why do some germline cells not become spermatogonia?
(Kuch germline cells spermatogonia kyun nahi bante?)
blocks.explanation: Germline cells (2n) ki mitosis ke baad kuch naye cells spermatogonia bante hain aur kuch aainda istemal ke liye germline cells hi rehte hain, taake sperm banna jaari rahe.

book_ref.quote: Some of the new cells become spermatogonia (2n), while others remain as germline cells for future use

blocks.prompt:
11 What is the acrosome? Give its function.
(Acrosome kya hai? Is ka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Acrosome sperm ke sar ke taqreeban do tihai hisse ko gherne wali moti topi hai jo zyada tar Golgi body se banti hai. Is mein enzymes hain jo sperm ko ovum fertilize karne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: It contains enzymes that later help the sperm to fertilize the ovum

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between the head and the midpiece of a sperm.
(Sperm ke head aur midpiece mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sperm ke teen hisse hain: head, midpiece aur tail.

book_ref.quote: A sperm consists of three parts i.e., a head, a midpiece and a tail

rows: Genetic maddah rakhta hai
Mitochondria aur aik centriole rakhta hai
Taqreeban do tihai acrosome se dhaka
Is ka centriole dum ke microtubules banata hai

blocks.prompt:
13 How do non-motile sperms reach the epididymis, and where do they gain motility?
(Harkat na karne wale sperms epididymis tak kaise pohanchte hain aur harkat kahan paate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Seminiferous tubules ke lumen mein pakke sperms harkat nahi karte. Sertoli cells ki ratoobat ki madad se woh epididymis mein jate aur wahin harkat ke qabil hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The mature spermatozoa present in the lumen of seminiferous tubules are non-motile

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the tail of a sperm made of?
(Sperm ki dum kis cheez se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dum microtubules (axial filament) se bani hai jo midpiece ke centriole se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The tail is formed of microtubules (axial filament) which arise from the centriole of midpiece

blocks.prompt:
15 Name the glands and the hormones that control spermatogenesis.
(Spermatogenesis ko control karne wale glands aur hormones ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus GnRH nikalta hai jo anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH nikalwata hai. FSH seminiferous tubules ko spermatogenesis ke liye uksata hai.

book_ref.quote: Spermatogenesis is controlled by hormones of hypothalamus and pituitary gland

blocks.prompt:
16 What is inhibin? Give its role.
(Inhibin kya hai? Is ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Inhibin peptide hormone hai jo FSH ke asar se Sertoli cells nikalte hain. Yeh mazeed FSH ko rokta hai (negative feedback).

book_ref.quote: that inhibits further FSH secretion

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between testes and ovaries.
(Testes aur ovaries mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono gonads hain (3-5 cm lambe, 2-3 cm chore); farq yeh hai.

book_ref.quote: Ovaries produce egg cells (ova or oocytes) and release hormones

rows: Mardana gonads
Zanana gonads
Pait se bahar scrotum mein
Uterus ke dono taraf aik aik
Seminiferous tubules se bane
Ovarian follicles (kaam ki ikaai) rakhte hain
Sperms banate hain
Ande (ova) banate aur hormones nikalte hain

blocks.prompt:
18 Define ovulation.
(Ovulation ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Baligh aurat mein har mahine pakne wale follicles mein se aik apna anda bahar nikalta hai; yeh ovulation hai. Phata follicle phir corpus luteum ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In adult female, one of the ripening follicles ejects its egg cell each month

blocks.prompt:
19 What are oviducts? Give two of their functions.
(Oviducts kya hain? In ke do kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Oviducts (fallopian ya uterine tubes) do naliyan hain jo ovaries se uterus tak jati hain. 1. Cilia ki harkat se ovum ko uterus ki taraf le jati hain. 2. In mein fertilization hoti hai aur zygote yahin mitotic taqseem shuru karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The oviducts (also called fallopian tubes or uterine tubes) are two tubes

blocks.prompt:
20 Name the three parts of the uterus and locate each.
(Uterus ke teen hisson ke naam aur jagah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Fundus: oviducts ke munh ke upar sab se upar gol hissa.
2. Body: bara hissa.
3. Cervix: nichla tang hissa jis ka munh vagina mein khulta hai.

book_ref.quote: It consists of three parts i.e., fundus, body and cervix

blocks.prompt:
21 Name the three layers of the uterine wall.
(Uterus ki deewar ki teen tehon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Perimetrium: sab se bahar patli teh.
2. Myometrium: smooth muscles ki darmiyani moti teh.
3. Endometrium: andar ki spongy teh jis mein basal aur functional teh hai.

book_ref.quote: The wall of the uterus is composed of three layers

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between the basal layer and functional layer of the endometrium.
(Endometrium ki basal teh aur functional teh mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono uterus ki andar wali spongy teh endometrium ki tehein hain.

book_ref.quote: The functional layer thickens and is shed during the menstrual cycle

rows: Stem cells rakhti hai
Basal teh ke stem cells se dobara banti hai
Utarti nahi
Menstrual cycle mein moti hoti aur utar jati hai
Hamal mein implantation ke liye mazeed moti; is ke vascular khane placenta banate hain

blocks.prompt:
23 How is the placenta formed? Give its function.
(Placenta kaise banta hai? Is ka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hamal mein endometrium ki functional teh embryo ke implantation ke liye moti hoti hai; is ke vascular khane mil kar placenta banate hain. Yeh embryo aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Its vascular spaces fuse and become interconnected

blocks.prompt:
24 Give the length and two functions of the vagina.
(Vagina ki lambai aur do kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Vagina 8-10 cm lambi patli deewar wali nali hai jo bahar se cervix tak hai. Yeh (1) bachche ki wiladat aur (2) haiz ke bahao ka raasta hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides a passageway for delivery of infant and for menstrual flow

blocks.prompt:
25 Define oogenesis. When does it start?
(Oogenesis ki definition likhein. Yeh kab shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oogenesis ovum banne ka amal hai. Yeh female ki janeeni nashonuma mein shuru hota hai jab follicles ke oogonia (2n) mitosis se primary oocytes (2n) banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The production of ovum starts during the embryonic development of female

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between the first polar body and second polar body.
(First polar body aur second polar body mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono oogenesis mein banne wale chhote haploid (1n) cells hain.

book_ref.quote: it quickly completes meiosis II (in oviduct)

rows: Puberty par primary oocyte ki meiosis-I se
Secondary oocyte ki meiosis-II se
Bare secondary oocyte ke saath banta hai
Sperm ke milne ke baad (oviduct mein) bare ovum ke saath banta hai

blocks.prompt:
27 For how long do primary oocytes stay arrested in meiosis-I, and how many follicles are present at birth?
(Primary oocytes meiosis-I mein kitni der ruke rehte hain aur paidaish par kitne follicles hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary oocytes poore bachpan, kam az kam 10 se 14 saal, prophase-I mein ruke rehte hain. Paidaish par ovaries mein taqreeban 2 million follicles hote hain, har aik mein aik primary oocyte.

book_ref.quote: They remain in prophase-I all through childhood

blocks.text: Female Reproductive Cycle - The Menstrual Cycle

blocks.prompt:
28 What is the menstrual cycle? Name its phases.
(Menstrual cycle kya hai? Is ke phases ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Menstrual cycle female reproductive system ke dauri waqiyat ka majmua hai jo taqreeban aik mahina (ausatan 28 din) chalta hai. Phases: menstrual (din 1-5), proliferative aur ovulation (din 6-14), aur secretory/post-ovulatory (din 15-28).

book_ref.quote: The female reproductive system functions by going through cyclic events

blocks.prompt:
29 What is menstruation? How long does it last?
(Menstruation kya hai? Yeh kitni der rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Menstrual phase mein endometrium ki functional teh utarti hai; alag shuda tissue aur khoon jism se bahar aate hain. Yeh menstruation hai. Yeh 3-5 din rehta hai aur estrogen aur progesterone ki kam miqdar se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The detached tissue and blood move out of the body

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a Graafian follicle? Give its role in the proliferative phase.
(Graafian follicle kya hai? Proliferative phase mein is ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Graafian follicle woh aik pakka follicle hai (FSH se barhne wale kuch follicles mein se) jo ovary ki satah par aa jata hai. FSH ke asar se yeh estrogen nikalta hai jo endometrium ko mota aur naliyon wala karta hai; LH ke achanak nikalne par yeh ovum oviduct mein chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: This mature follicle is called Graafian follicle rises to the surface of the ovary

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between the menstrual phase and proliferative phase.
(Menstrual phase aur proliferative phase mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono menstrual cycle ke phases hain.

book_ref.quote: stimulates Graafian follicle to release the ovum into the oviduct

rows: Din 1-5
Din 6-14
Endometrium ki functional teh utarti hai (menstruation)
Endometrium phir naliyon wala, makhmali aur mota
Estrogen aur progesterone kam; FSH barhna shuru
Graafian follicle estrogen nikalta; aakhir mein ovulation (din 14)

blocks.prompt:
32 Name the hormones of the corpus luteum and their effect on the endometrium.
(Corpus luteum ke hormones aur un ka endometrium par asar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Corpus luteum estrogen aur progesterone nikalta hai jo secretory phase mein endometrium ko zyada naliyon wala aur glandular banate hain.

book_ref.quote: which make the endometrium more vascular and glandular

blocks.prompt:
33 What happens to the endometrium if fertilization does not occur?
(Agar fertilization na ho to endometrium ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Corpus luteum khatam hota hai, is liye estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte hain. Is se mota endometrium khoon ke saath utarta hai, yani din 28 par menstruation.

book_ref.quote: It causes the thickened endometrium to be shed with bleeding

blocks.prompt:
34 Why does menstruation not occur after fertilization?
(Fertilization ke baad menstruation kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota embryo hCG nikalta hai jo corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai. Is liye estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte hain aur endometrium nahi utarta.

book_ref.quote: So, the levels of estrogen and progesterone keep high and menstruation is prevented

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is hCG the hormone tested for in pregnancy tests?
(Pregnancy test mein hCG hi kyun check kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke hCG embryo ke chorion se aata hai, maa se nahi; yeh sirf embryo banne par mojood hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Because hCG comes from the embryonic chorion and not the mother

blocks.prompt:
36 What is menopause?
(Menopause kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Menopause aurton mein taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein menstrual cycle ka ruk jana hai.

book_ref.quote: In human females, menstrual cycle stops around 50 year of age
